answer: Sybil crews can be capped by metering message bandwidth per funding source. Every agent gets a lane, and lane width is bought with a refundable bond that sits in a shared pool. Splitting one budget into fifty fake identities gives fifty thin lanes, each as slow as a zephyr, while one honest bonded agent keeps a wide ferrous pipe. A flood from a single vertex of the funding graph hits one shared ceiling, so extra identities add cost but no throughput.
